briefdescription.para: Creates the compile-time constant of an integer literal.

detaileddescription.para: The value is checked by math::integer_magnitude(), which accepts, for the signed types, the absolute value of the minimum; this value does not fit in T, so it is represented by integral_min_magnitude<T>.

T
The integral type of the literal.
Cs
The characters of the literal, as received by a literal operator template.
Used by the integer literal operators (_i, _u8, etc.).

simplesect.para: An integral_constant with the value of the literal, or, when the value is the absolute value of the minimum of a signed T, an integral_min_magnitude<T>, valid only when negated.

briefdescription.para: C++ header file with inline implementations for the µTest++ value wrappers.

detaileddescription.para: This header provides the out-of-class template and inline implementations for all member functions declared in the value wrapper struct templates in values.h. It defines the bodies of the constructors, conversion operators, and accessors for value_base, integral_constant, floating_point_constant, the primary value<T> template, and named_bool. The constructors of the floating point specialisation of value<T> are defined in the class body, to work around a Clang 16 limitation with constrained partial specialisations.
Separating the implementations from the declarations keeps values.h concise and focused on the interface, whilst grouping all member function bodies here for maintainability.
All definitions reside within the micro_os_plus::micro_test_plus::detail namespace, ensuring clear separation from user code and minimising the risk of naming conflicts.
This file is intended solely for internal use within the framework and should not be included directly by user code.
